identifierSource.description: The source segment this project's own identifiers carry in a cross-source citation. Defaults to the project name in lower kebab case.

citedSources.description: Other sources a citation in this project may name, beyond owasp, rfc, and litespec.

size.description: The size of this project. Small requires the core record types with Architecture and Integration test projects; large adds problems, features, journeys and scenarios with the Acceptance project.

shape.description: The shape of this project: server for a project with a backend, client-only for a project with frontends and no backend. Defaults to server.

stacks.description: The stacks this project builds with: dotnet for the backend, and one per frontend from its platform (react, svelte, blazor, or android).

optionalTypes.description: The optional record types this project writes beside what its size requires.

stackConfig.description: Per-stack configuration, keyed by stack id. Each stack documents its own keys beside this schema.

dotnet.description: Paths the model builder reads for the .NET backend. Each supports one segment wildcard expanding to the first matching folder.

application.description: The Application project the model builder reads. Defaults to apps/api/src/*.Application.

domain.description: The Domain project the model builder reads. Defaults to apps/api/src/*.Domain.

infrastructure.description: The Infrastructure project the model builder reads. Defaults to apps/api/src/*.Infrastructure.

webapi.description: The WebApi project the model builder reads. Defaults to apps/api/src/*.WebApi.

worker.description: The Worker project the model builder reads. Defaults to apps/api/src/*.Worker.

apiSolution.description: Path to the API solution. A consumer with no backend omits it and records the decision that it has none.

sharedKernel.description: The one folder holding the domain shared kernel, where reasonless names are allowed. Defaults to none.

templateStore.description: The one C# file holding the notification template store: its top-level dictionary keys are the template keys, and its texts write parameters as {{PascalCaseName}}. Defaults to none, which leaves the template checks silent.

proof.description: How the model builder confirms proof claims for this project.

jobTriggerSteps.description: Steps classes whose when steps run a job, such as one that moves a simulated clock.

outcomeOnlySteps.description: Steps classes whose then steps state only that a request succeeded or was refused.

marks.description: The mark style every code element and test uses to name its record: xml for documentation tags, attribute for generated attributes. Defaults to xml.

check.description: How the checks treat this project.

phase.description: working: proof findings block as their tier states. frozen: the project holds its tests still, so proof findings report without blocking. Defaults to working.

dependencies.description: The dependency gate: the licences every shipped package may carry without an admitting decision.

licences.description: SPDX licence identifiers the project accepts, such as MIT and Apache-2.0.

review.description: How this project reviews record changes: the veto window after which a tier-3 draft question carrying a recommendation auto-approves, and the security reviewer who owns the security queue.

vetoWindowDays.description: Days after decideBy before a tier-3 draft question carrying a recommendation auto-approves. Defaults to 7.

sampleShare.description: The share of a tier-3 batch that batch approval samples, drawn from the records with the lowest semantic hashes and at least one record. Defaults to 0.1.

securityReviewer.description: The owner who reviews access widenings, new outside calls and new personal-data flows.

refusals.description: The refusal codes the derived generic results carry, with the HTTP status and client vocabulary each declared code answers in.

forbidden.description: The code the derived forbidden result carries. Defaults to authorization.forbidden.

invalidInput.description: The code the derived invalid-input result carries. Defaults to request.validation-failed.

statuses.description: The HTTP status each declared refusal code answers with, by refusal code. A test asserting the status confirms the refusal.

aliases.description: The client refusal vocabulary translated to declared codes, by client code. A test asserting the client code confirms the declared refusal.

prefixes.description: Refusal-code prefixes the project shares across modules, such as a shared kernel, beside every declared module and the generic request, authorization and client prefixes.

composed.description: Refusal codes the project builds at run time from a key, each a template with one {key} placeholder after a prefix and a dot, such as uniqueness.{key}-taken for a lost uniqueness key. A code matching a template is raised where its key is a literal in the code.

vocabulary.description: The domain verbs, phrasal verbs and retired synonyms the project adds to the baseline use-case vocabulary LiteSpec ships. Every use-case name opens with a baseline or project verb.

verbs.description: The single-word domain verbs the project adds to the baseline; they name either kind.

queryVerbs.description: Project verbs that open only a query, beside the baseline reading verbs.

phrasal.description: Multi-word verbs counted as one opening, such as check-in.

retired.description: Retired synonyms mapped to their replacement verb, beside the synonyms the baseline retires.

lookalikeIgnore.description: Lookalike pairs the term-lookalike check skips, each naming both forms as "a|b", such as "online|on-line" for a compound that splits into real words by accident.

pastTense.description: The past tense of project domain verbs, by verb, beside the baseline table. A verb with no entry tenses regularly.

adoption.description: The adoption transcription mode this project still runs under, if any. After the named decision is approved, no Behavior record may stay transcribed.

transcriptionEndsWith.description: The decision whose approval ends transcription mode.

constraints.description: Present once the project has stated which outside constraints apply to it, possibly none.

owners.description: The closed list of names a record owner comes from. Each entry is a plain name or an object mapping a readable name to its CODEOWNERS handles. Names are unique across both forms.

reviewedLiteSpecVersion.description: The LiteSpec release whose complete contract this project last reviewed.

docs.description: Root of the specification tree. Every Markdown file under it carries a metadata block unless the path is listed in unstructuredDocs.

glossary.description: The project glossary, validated against schemas/glossary.schema.json. Defaults to glossary.json under the documentation root.

glossaryScan.description: Glob patterns naming the non-Markdown surfaces the vocabulary is checked over: source, interface copy, the API contract, acceptance tests. Repository-relative. A scope in the glossary record is matched against the repository-relative path for these files. Each pattern must match at least one file.

unstructuredDocs.description: Paths whose Markdown is navigation or prose rather than specification.

records.description: Home folders per record type, where they differ from the defaults the model states.

testRoots.description: Directories holding automated test source. A scenario is proved from one of these, as a test whose steps call the use case and assert the result.

testResults.description: Where the latest test run results live, so passing and failing proof is read from them. Defaults to the test result files under the test roots.

alerts.description: The alert rule files or folders: YAML in the shape Prometheus rule files and Grafana alert provisioning share, groups[].rules[] with labels.

operations.description: The deployment, proxy, host and CI workflow files or folders that carry follows marks in their # comments.

checkResults.description: Where drill and harness check results live as JSON files. Defaults to docs/proof/checks.

sbom.description: The bill of materials files or folders: SPDX or CycloneDX JSON the CI generates.

contract.description: The committed OpenAPI document, so the model check compares each operation's x-litespec-use-case with its endpoint's mark.

apiClient.description: The generated API client the frontends import, so route calls resolve to the use cases they reach.

surfaces.description: The surfaces outside paths.frontends that invoke a use case: a command-line tool, a distributed server, a background host, an event reaction. Each frontend is already a surface under its own name. A Consumers row names one of these.

uiPackage.description: The workspace's one shared UI package: the registry configuration, the copied primitive source, the token stylesheet, the source lock, and the design contract. A workspace with no controlled web frontend omits it.

uiPatterns.description: The workspace UI pattern catalog, validated against schemas/ui-pattern-catalog.schema.json. A workspace that records no pattern decisions omits it.

platform.description: The frontend stack. Required on every entry, so a frontend outside the controlled UI contract declares that position instead of omitting the field.

entryPoint.description: The browser or device entry point this frontend serves. Screens it drafts and use cases it reaches are read through this entry point.

refusalDictionary.description: The refusal dictionary for this frontend: the file or folder holding one sentence per refusal code, which result-unshown reads.

routeSuite.description: The route suite for this frontend: the file or folder the route-suite check reads.

visualGoldens.description: The visual golden folder for this frontend: the folder holding the visual goldens the route-suite check reads.

sites.description: The static public websites this consumer ships beside its application. Each entry names the site, its directory, and the generator that builds it.

generator.description: The static generator that builds the site.

allOf.$comment: A controlled web frontend composes the shared package, so declaring one makes the package required. A workspace whose frontends are all outside the contract declares no package.

exampleWordLimit.description: The word bound an Example section stays within. Omitted, the recorded default of 120 applies, and the validator refuses a value below 40.

prohibitedKinds.description: Record types or page styles this consumer does not use. A page declaring one is refused.

selectedExtensions.description: Extensions active for this project. Each entry records the criterion that was met and the date the selection is next reviewed, so a selection that costs nothing to keep still expires. The 3.0 extensions are privacy, devices, automation, workflow-engine, pipeline, queues and ai.

releaseStage.description: The release stage the stage extension declares: pre-production until a deployment holds customer data, production after the promotion decision.

deferredProvisions.description: The provisions this selection defers, each with the date the deferral ends. Only the stage extension defers provisions.

primitives.description: The directory holding the registry source the pinned CLI copied in.

publicExports.description: The entry points applications may import. A primitive the composites are built from is not one of them.

profile.description: The density profile this frontend composes the shared package at.

globalCss.description: The one stylesheet this frontend declares, which imports the shared package's tokens.
